messages:
harry_csm: Weekly check-in for LumenSys 3: quick token + throughput flags — keeping short.

jana_cs: numbers from the dashboard this morning:

jana_cs: WoW tokens: +25% (400k -> 500k). QoQ tokens: +92%.
jana_cs: Peak sustained throughput: 60 rps baseline -> 130 rps daytime peak.
jana_cs: p95 latency: 180ms -> 320ms WoW.
jana_cs: 5xx error rate: 0.2% -> 0.9%. 4xx (client) increased to 1.6% (misconfigs).
jana_cs: Spend WoW: +35% (combination of longer responses + retries).

nina_eng: noted. Any recent client changes or model swaps?

jana_cs: LumenSys switched roaming model to redwood-lite-3b-quant on 2024-11-10 and bumped default max_tokens from 128 -> 384 for search summaries.

sam_ops: pulling runtime traces and recent deploys now. metrics-bot: fetching metrics for customer_id='lumensys' from 2464900000..2465006000

metrics-bot: dashboard snapshot uploaded: https://csdash.redwood/lumensys/weekly/2465006789

sam_ops: quick grep: two client-side config pushes on 11/10 and 11/11. No infra deploy in that window. Traces show request queue depth rising in the 11:00-15:00 UTC window.

nina_eng: redwood-lite-3b-quant is cheaper per token but can increase encoder time for long-contexts; likely queuing. Also client retries amplify load.

harry_csm: so root causes: model variant + longer tokens + client retry loop. Renewal risk = medium unless we act to curb spend and explain tradeoffs.

nina_eng: tactical plan: 1) enable per-customer prefix cache (if they accept), 2) set soft max_tokens=256 via policy, 3) add a short retry backoff on client to reduce amplification.

jana_cs: can we estimate impact if we enable prefix cache + cap tokens?

nina_eng: quick back-of-envelope: if effective avg tokens drop from 300 -> 200 (cache + cap), tokens WoW could go -33% and spend -28%. p95 latency might drop ~80ms in peak.

sam_ops: I can flip a feature flag to enable prefix cache for them and push per-customer policy to enforce soft cap. Will route 5% traffic to a control group first.

harry_csm: please schedule the change during low window. When can you do it?

sam_ops: I can deploy the feature flag 2024-11-15 02:00 UTC, monitor for 90 minutes. Will route 5% to control for 30m, then ramp to 100% if stable.

jana_cs: I'll prepare a short customer note explaining why we're activating cache + soft cap and offer a call to adjust summary lengths.

metrics-bot: quick query used for snapshot:
```sql
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) as tokens, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95_latency
FROM customer_metrics
WHERE customer_id = 'lumensys' AND date >= '2024-10-01'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 21;
```

harry_csm: action items:
- sam_ops: enable prefix caching feature flag + soft max_tokens policy (2024-11-15 02:00 UTC), control 5% traffic first.
- nina_eng: prototype client retry backoff guidance and a short PR with example snippet.
- jana_cs: customer note + call invite (offer 30m)
- metrics-bot: post delta snapshot after 90m monitoring window.

jana_cs: small client snippet I'll suggest for retry backoff:
```js
// client: exponential backoff with jitter
async function retryCall(fn, attempts=3) {
  let delay = 200;
  for (let i=0; i<attempts; i++) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch(e) {
      await sleep(delay + Math.random()*100);
      delay *= 2;
    }
  }
  throw new Error('max retries');
}
```

nina_eng: good. That will cut retry storms if their app was aggressive.

metrics-bot: update (after 90m): tokens WoW reduced 29% vs pre-change in control sample, p95 down ~70ms, 5xx down to 0.3%. Spend projection down ~24% for next week if trends hold. Dashboard delta: https://csdash.redwood/lumensys/deltas/2465006789

harry_csm: great outcome. I'll mark renewal risk as low for now but want a follow-up in two weeks to verify stable trends.

sam_ops: keeping watch for 48h. ping if any regressions.

jana_cs: scheduling the 30m enablement call for 2024-11-15 15:00 UTC. Invites sent.

harry_csm: closing this weekly thread 3: reopen if spikes reappear. Thanks team :thumbsup:
